Class ResponseSubscriberElements<X,T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.PulledBodyElements<T>
io.micronaut.http.client.internal.ResponseSubscriberElements<X,T>
Type Parameters:
X - The body type of an emitted response
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
BodyElements<T>, AutoCloseable, Subscriber<HttpResponse<X>>
@Internal public final class ResponseSubscriberElements<X,T> extends PulledBodyElements<T> implements Subscriber<HttpResponse<X>>
The elements of a reactive exchange that emits each piece of the body wrapped in the response, such as SseClient.exchangeEventStream or StreamingHttpClient.exchangeStream: the first emitted response completes the exchange, and each read requests the next one.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • exchange

      public static <X,T> CompletableFuture<HttpResponse<BodyElements<T>>> exchange(Publisher<? extends HttpResponse<X>> responses, Function<? super X, ? extends T> element)
      Subscribe to the responses of a reactive exchange. Cancelling the stage before the first response arrived cancels the subscription.
      Type Parameters:
      X - The body type of an emitted response
      T - The type of an element
      Parameters:
      responses - The responses, each with a piece of the body, or without a body
      element - The element of the body of a response
      Returns:
      Completes with the first response, whose body is the elements

    • demand

      protected void demand()
      Description copied from class: PulledBodyElements
      Ask the source for more elements. Called by a read that found nothing available, outside the lock. The source answers with PulledBodyElements.push(T), PulledBodyElements.end() or PulledBodyElements.fail(Throwable); a source that produced nothing for the read must ask itself again while PulledBodyElements.isWaiting().
      Specified by:
      demand in class PulledBodyElements<T>
